what: The record that MOXIR's show version (Known · full, copied from PONYO 10-04) is the git build of its rig file plus the parts named in notFromGit. Re-check it with the command in rebuild.check. Audit D1, docs/ai/audits/moxir-2026-10-05/D-data-sync.md (branch docs/moxir-audit-2026-10-05).

listed.note: The list's fingerprint is the project at document version 1 (read back from the op log on dev and on local: replaceDocument by the copy, then nothing else).

afterListing.tool: scripts/rigbuild/apply-picture.mjs (branch feat/apply-picture-2026-10-04, PR #761, not in dev yet); undo file ~/.di/picture-undo/moxir-hall-known-full-2026-10-04T20-03-07-147Z.json on aylmo

rebuild.how: Offline, no server, no Blender: scripts/production/rebuild-compare.mjs replays each step a version is made by with the repo's own pure functions and compares, per entity and field, with the project; then puts every git-built part into the project's document and takes the list's fingerprint (versionList.mjs fingerprintOf). Equal fingerprint = every git-built part is identical.
steps: versions.mjs --report (versions-report.mjs: moxir.mjs moxirDocument + patchMoxir) — the typed, patched lamps and effects, hall file from the versions file
load-plot.mjs piecesFromRigBoxes — the truss line and decks as pieces; piece bodies content-addressed (sha256 of scripts/rigbuild/pieces/*.glb)
load-version.mjs step 4 — rig-show rentalList, rigLooks (looks.mjs rigLooksFrom), rigVariant (variantOf)
load-version.mjs --look k-monolith --nominal — every lamp's aim, colour, light and haze (rig-lib buildRig)
the server's normaliser (projectSchema.js normalizeEntity) to its fixed point — e.g. beam.haze 1.5 is held as 1

measured.by: aylmo, read-only GETs (document, ops) with each install's admin token
alsoIdentical: rigbuild-truss-3m.glb and rigbuild-deck-2x1.glb: the project's asset ids are the sha256 of the files in git

hallModel.why: scripts/place/hall.py builds the hall in Blender (import bpy) and realism.mjs makes its night copy; not rebuilt (no Blender on aylmo, heat rule). The bytes are held only as this project's asset on dev and local; no other project and no backup on aylmo holds them (audit D5, D9).

rigBounce.why: realism.mjs measures it off the day hall model, which is not in git

notFromGit.worldRenderVsToolDefaults: Not the tools' defaults, and the arguments are not recorded: fog.far 80 and atmosphere.scattering 0.02 fit realism.mjs --scattering 0.02 (1.6/0.02 = 80; commit 5389d9c9 notes σ 0.02); ambientLight #a39c92 at 0.1 (realism writes black 0) and shadowCasting enabled (nightOps gives false for this rig) come from steps nobody recorded.
